claim: For exported certificates, ACM manages renewals and sends notifications when new certificates are available, and the ACM guide says that you must manage the deployment process yourself; the guide also says that you can automate exportable certificates issued from ACM through AWS Workload Credentials Provider.

evidence.quote: You must manage the deployment process for exported certificates.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager exportable public certificates

evidence.quote: ACM manages renewals and sends notifications when new certificates are available.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager exportable public certificates

evidence.quote: Alternatively, if you cannot use ACME, you can automate exportable certificates issued from ACM through AWS Workload Credentials Provider.
